points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 爱德华·马奈1832年1月23日出生于巴黎一个富裕的中产阶级家庭。父亲是高级公务员，母亲是外交官的女儿。马奈从小接受良好的教育，被期望成为一名海军军官。1841年，他就读于路易大帝中学，1848年按照父亲意愿前往巴西里约热内卢学习海军，但这段经历短暂，他很快返回巴黎，表明自己不想从事航海事业，而是立志成为一名艺术家。
points.descriptionEn: Édouard Manet was born on January 23, 1832, in Paris to a wealthy middle-class family. His father was a high-ranking civil servant, and his mother was the daughter of a diplomat. Manet received an excellent education and was expected to become a naval officer. In 1841, he attended the Lycée Louis-le-Grand, and in 1848, following his father's wishes, he traveled to Rio de Janeiro to study naval science. However, this experience was brief, and he soon returned to Paris, indicating his preference for becoming an artist rather than pursuing a naval career.

points.title: 艺术学习时期
points.description: 回到巴黎后，马奈开始正式学习绘画。他先是跟随学院派画家托马斯·库图尔学习，但很快对传统学院派教学方法感到不满。在此期间，他大量临摹卢浮宫和卢森堡宫中的老大师作品，特别是委拉斯开兹、戈雅和委罗内塞的作品。这一时期，马奈还前往德国、意大利和荷兰旅行，研究当地艺术。1856年，他离开库图尔的画室，开始在巴黎建立自己的工作室，开始创作具有个人风格的作品。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to Paris, Manet began formal art studies. He first studied under the academic painter Thomas Couture but soon became dissatisfied with traditional academic teaching methods. During this period, he extensively copied works of old masters from the Louvre and Luxembourg Palace, particularly those by Velázquez, Goya, and Veronese. Manet also traveled to Germany, Italy, and the Netherlands to study local art. In 1856, he left Couture's studio and established his own studio in Paris, beginning to create works with his personal style.

points.title: 争议与突破
points.description: 1863年，马奈的作品《草地上的午餐》在落选者沙龙上展出，引发巨大争议。这幅作品将现代人物置于古典场景中，被批评为粗俗和不道德。1865年，他的另一幅作品《奥林匹亚》再次引起轩然大波，画中裸女直视观众，被传统主义者视为对艺术的亵渎。尽管面临批评，马奈的作品开始受到年轻艺术家的关注，包括莫奈、雷诺阿等人，他们后来成为印象派的核心成员。这一时期，马奈开始探索现代生活题材，将巴黎的咖啡馆、酒吧和休闲场所作为创作主题。
points.descriptionEn: In 1863, Manet's painting 'Le Déjeuner sur l'herbe' was exhibited in the Salon of the Refused, causing huge controversy. The work placed modern figures in a classical setting and was criticized as vulgar and immoral. In 1865, his other work 'Olympia' again caused a sensation, with its nude woman directly confronting the viewer, seen by traditionalists as desecrating art. Despite the criticism, Manet's work began to attract the attention of younger artists including Monet, Renoir, and others who later became core members of the Impressionist movement. During this period, Manet began exploring modern life themes, depicting Parisian cafes, bars, and leisure venues as subjects.

points.title: 印象派影响
points.description: 尽管马奈从未参加过印象派的展览，但他与印象派画家保持着密切联系，并对他们的创作产生了重要影响。1866年后，马奈的作品风格开始更加明亮，色彩更加鲜明，受到印象派光影处理技巧的影响。他创作了《女神游乐厅的吧台》、《吹短笛的男孩》等标志性作品。1870年普法战争期间，马奈短暂参军，后因病退役。战后，他继续创作，同时积极支持年轻艺术家。1874年，印象派举办第一次独立展览，虽然马奈没有参展，但他与印象派的关系更加密切，被视为连接传统与创新的桥梁。
points.descriptionEn: Although Manet never participated in Impressionist exhibitions, he maintained close connections with Impressionist painters and significantly influenced their work. After 1866, Manet's style became brighter with more vivid colors, influenced by Impressionist techniques of light and shadow. He created iconic works such as 'A Bar at the Folies-Bergère' and 'The Fifer.' During the Franco-Prussian War in 1870, Manet briefly served in the army but was discharged due to illness. After the war, he continued creating while actively supporting young artists. In 1874, when the Impressionists held their first independent exhibition, Manet did not participate but his connection with them grew stronger, positioning him as a bridge between tradition and innovation.

points.title: 晚年与遗产
points.description: 1870年代后期，马奈的健康状况开始恶化，患有梅毒和风湿病，但仍坚持创作。他的晚期作品如《在温室里》和《弗里-贝热尔酒吧》展现了对色彩和光影的进一步探索。1881年，法国政府授予马奈荣誉军团勋章，这是对他艺术成就的官方认可。1883年4月30日，马奈因梅毒并发症在巴黎去世，享年51岁。马奈虽然从未参加过印象派展览，但他被视为印象派的先驱和重要影响者。他的作品打破了传统绘画的束缚，将现代生活引入艺术，为后来的现代艺术开辟了道路。马奈的遗产不仅体现在他的绘画作品中，还体现在他对艺术传统的挑战和对现代性的探索上。
points.descriptionEn: In the late 1870s, Manet's health began to deteriorate due to syphilis and rheumatism, but he continued to create. His late works such as 'In the Greenhouse' and 'At the Café de la Nouvelle Athènes' show further exploration of color and light. In 1881, the French government awarded Manet the Legion of Honour, official recognition of his artistic achievements. On April 30, 1883, Manet died in Paris at the age of 51 from complications of syphilis. Although Manet never participated in Impressionist exhibitions, he is regarded as a pioneer and significant influence on the movement. His works broke free from traditional painting constraints, introducing modern life into art and paving the way for later modern art. Manet's legacy is reflected not only in his paintings but also in his challenge to artistic tradition and exploration of modernity.

supporter.zh: 马奈被视为现代艺术的先驱和革命者。他勇敢地挑战了学院派的僵化传统，将现代生活题材引入绘画，打破了古典艺术的桎梏。他的大胆用色、平面化处理和对日常生活的关注，为印象派乃至整个现代艺术运动开辟了道路。马奈的作品不仅具有美学价值，更体现了对艺术自由的追求和对社会现实的关注，他的艺术精神激励了后世无数艺术家突破传统束缚，探索新的表现形式。
supporter.en: Manet is regarded as a pioneer and revolutionary of modern art. He bravely challenged the rigid traditions of academic painting, introducing modern life subjects into art and breaking the shackles of classical art. His bold use of color, flat处理, and focus on daily life paved the way for Impressionism and the entire modern art movement. Manet's works possess not only aesthetic value but also embody the pursuit of artistic freedom and concern for social reality. His artistic spirit has inspired countless later artists to break free from traditional constraints and explore new forms of expression.

critic.zh: 批评者认为马奈的作品缺乏真正的深度和技术精湛度。他们指责马奈过于关注表面的现代性而牺牲了绘画的技巧和内涵，认为他的作品粗糙、不完整，缺乏传统大师的精湛技艺。此外，一些批评者认为马奈对女性形象的描绘带有物化色彩，如《奥林匹亚》中的裸女被批评为缺乏情感和尊严。还有人指出马奈虽然被视作印象派先驱，但他从未真正接受印象派的光影理论，导致他的艺术创新不够彻底。
critic.en: Critics argue that Manet's works lack true depth and technical sophistication. They accuse Manet of focusing too much on surface modernity at the expense of painting technique and substance, considering his works rough, incomplete, and lacking the masterful skill of traditional artists. Additionally, some critics believe that Manet's depictions of women objectify them, with the nude in 'Olympia' criticized as lacking emotion and dignity. Others point out that although Manet is regarded as a precursor to Impressionism, he never fully embraced Impressionist theories of light and shadow, resulting in incomplete artistic innovation.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，马奈被定位为连接传统与现代艺术的关键桥梁。他既尊重老大师的技法，又大胆创新，将现代生活引入艺术，为印象派的形成奠定了基础。马奈的作品反映了19世纪巴黎社会的变迁，捕捉了现代都市生活的瞬间。在流行文化中，马奈的形象常与艺术革命和反叛精神联系在一起，他的作品成为艺术史上的标志性符号。历史学界认为，马奈的艺术成就不仅在于他创造了新的绘画风格，更在于他挑战了艺术与社会的关系，重新定义了艺术的功能和边界。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Manet is positioned as a crucial bridge connecting traditional and modern art. He respected the techniques of old masters while boldly innovating, introducing modern life into art and laying the foundation for Impressionism. Manet's works reflect the changing society of 19th-century Paris, capturing moments of modern urban life. In popular culture, Manet is often associated with artistic revolution and rebellious spirit, with his works becoming iconic symbols in art history. Historians believe that Manet's artistic achievements lie not only in creating a new painting style but in challenging the relationship between art and society, redefining the function and boundaries of art.

self.zh: 我画的是我所看到的，而不是别人所期望我看到的。
self.en: I paint what I see, and not what others want me to see.

others.zh: 马奈是一位伟大的画家，他教会了我们如何用眼睛去看，而不是用头脑去思考。
others.en: Manet was a great painter who taught us how to see with our eyes, not with our minds.
